title: Sweet and Savory Confit Chicken
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring confit chicken, sweet tomato sauce, and a hint of French charm.
instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the confit of garlic and herbs.
Cook, stirring occasionally, for 2-3 minutes or until fragrant.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes or until they start to caramelize.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-12 minutes or until the sauce has thickened.
Return the chicken to the pot and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has bubbled and thickened.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
